custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425613 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425613-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding a part request for part A, quantity 1, not yet received.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425613 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; in the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425613-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Part. Do not receive it.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
